habitat: Singly or in pairs in coastal and lowland forest, riverine forest, mixed bushveld and thornveld, usually feeding in the mid and lower strata.
summary: A fairly common resident. Large, with a very heavy bill, a grey hood, a white patch in front of the yellow eye, green upperparts, a yellow belly and an orange breast. The immature has a horn-coloured bill. The characteristic call is a drawn-out hooooooooooop, and it also makes a clip-clip sound. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.
